question: In which of these battles did the British East India Company win a decisive victory over the Nawab of Bengal on 23 June 1757?
solution:
The correct answer is __**War of Plassy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **British East India Company,** led by Robert Clive, decisively defeated **Nawab **of **Bengal **and his **French allies **at the **Battle of Plassey** on **June 23,** **1757.**
 
• The chief commander of **Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah, Mir Jafar,** defected, which allowed the victory.
 
• The conflict aided in **Bengal's capture **by the British East India Company.
 
• They acquired **control **of the majority of the remaining **Indian subcontinent, **including **Burma**, during the course of following **100 years.**
 
• On the banks of the **Hooghly River,** a place called **Palashi **(or Plassey in English) was the site of the battle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Battle of Saragarhi:**

 
 
• **​**The** British Raj and Afghan tribesmen **engaged in the** Battle of Saragarhi **as a last-ditch effort prior to the **Tirah Campaign.**
 
• On **September 12, 1897,** Fort Gulistan and Fort Lockhart were cut off by an estimated 12,000 to 24,000 Orakzai and Afridi tribesmen who were spotted nearby, at Samana Suk, and in the area of Saragarhi.
 
 
 
• **Battle of Buxar:**
 
 
• **​**The British East India Company's forces, commanded by** Hector Munro,** engaged the united armies of **Mir Qasim,** the Nawab of Bengal until 1764, **Shuja-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh, **and **Shah Alam II, the Mughal Emperor, **at the Battle of Buxar on **October 22 and 23, 1764.**
 
 
 
• **Battle of Imphal:**
 
 
• **​**From March to** July 1944,** the area surrounding Imphal, the state capital of **Manipur **in Northeast India, saw action in the **Battle of Imphal.**
 
• **Japanese army **attempted to invade India and defeat the Allied forces at Imphal, but they suffered significant losses on their way back into **Burma**.
